name: Michelle's Sanctuary
reason: A sleep-story brand rather than a teacher: Michelle Hotaling (the voice behind it, named on her Venmo and Aura pages) writes and narrates bedtime stories and sleep meditations offered 'for relaxation and entertainment purposes only', with no classes, courses, sessions or books of her own; her site is framed around her own insomnia and quotes listeners saying she cured their insomnia and pain, and her popular Insight Timer tracks are titled for insomnia, migraine and pain relief, so almost nothing would pass the health-claim rule. Email michellessanctuary@gmail.com is published on michellessanctuary.com if she is ever reconsidered.
